basic_info.description: Located in the heart of Russian Hill just steps from lively Polk Street, this beautiful Edwardian 1 bed / 1 bath condo blends timeless San Francisco charm and architecture with modern comforts. Boasting original hardwood floors, high ceilings, and seamless flow between the living & dining room, the home is perfect for both relaxing and entertaining. The updated kitchen features stainless steel appliances and outdoor access, while the generous sized bedroom offers a spacious closet and direct access to a classic clawfoot tub bathroom with extra storage space. Enjoy serene city and mountain views from your cozy office nook which acts as a perfect work from home station. With a spacious storage unit and access to a beautifully maintained shared common space, this condo offers both convenience and character in one of SF's most coveted neighborhoods.
